answers.rationale: The requirement specifies arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers, bus sections, tie breakers, and accessories for a complete operational system. The CROWN-ARMV product matches these specifications as it provides metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear with arc-resistant construction and vacuum circuit breakers, and can be engineered to meet the specific requirements of the contract documents.
This requirement pertains to compliance with standards and codes, which is not a product-specific requirement. The bid manager should address this aspect in the proposal.
